parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human Orexin/Hypocretin receptor type 1 (CHEMBL5113) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary, filtering by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5113 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return columns molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
